profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, and trades under the ticker DDOG. Its own site describes it as offering cloud monitoring as a service, letting users see metrics from all of their apps, tools and services in one place, with a free trial available. The site also describes integrating security and observability to help organizations defend against AI-powered attacks, including decoding runtime execution, reducing exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carrying out detection and response.

The company's SEC filing record lists it under CIK 0001561550. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it. Its recorded law exposure is in New York, with a count of 459.
